SCRS/2020/078

Introduction

Introduction

  • A4a is a statistical catch-at-age stock assessment model (Jardim et al., 2015)

  • Is defined by submodels for F-at-age, abundance indices catchability-at-age, recruitment, observation variance of catch and abundance indices-at-age and population’s age structure in the first year

  • Baranov’s equation for the catches is assumed

  • lognormal errors for the catch and indices

  • Works forward in time

  • Implemented in R statistical software - part of the FLR library (Kell et al., 2007)

Materials and Methods

Materials and Methods

Catch Data

  • Catch-at-age data since 1985
  • plus group 5
  • fbar at 2 - 4

CPUE Data

  • Five standardized CPUE series

    • Greek longliners since 1987
    • Moroccan longliners since 2012
    • Spanish longliners since 1988
    • Ligurian longliners since 2010
    • Sicilian longliners from 1991 to 2009

  • Representative of age groups 2 - 4

CPUE indices

Candidate Runs

  • Many preliminary trials with:

    • Full time series
    • Various assumptions for the different submodels
    • Excluding some of the indices

  • Four trials considered:

    • Constant M = 0.2
    • M vector - Lorenzen’s formulation
    • Including estimated Discards and constant M
    • Including estimated Discards and Lorenzen M

Model setup

The model setup is the same for all runs

  • Fishing mortality \(\mathbf{F}\) \[F: \quad \sim s(year, k = 17) + s(age, k = 3)\]
  • Recruitment \(\mathbf{R}\) \[R:\quad \sim s(year, k = 15)\]
  • catchability \(\mathbf{Q}\)

\[ Q : \begin{cases} \sim 1, &\quad \text{Greek longline}\\ \sim 1, &\quad \text{Spanish longline}\\ \sim s(year, k=3), &\quad \text{Moroccan longline}\\ \sim s(year, k=3), &\quad \text{Ligurian longline}\\ \sim 1, &\quad \text{Sicilian longline}\\ \end{cases} \]

Model setup

  • observation variance \(\mathbf{\sigma^2}\) of the catches

\[ \sigma^2 \sim s(age, k = 3)\] - variance of the indices \[ \tau^{2}_{s} \sim 1,\quad \text{for all indices } s\]

  • initial age structure \(\mathbf{N_1}\)

\[ N : \quad\sim s(age, k =3)\]
